text:
Maya CSM: Heads-up — Apollo's QBR is next week and finance flagged token burn as a renewal risk. Putting together a quick spend-health runbook and need alignment on action items. Can folks drop ETA on the items below?

Ethan AE: I can join the customer call Tue 11am PT, I'll need a one-pager on recommended limits + migration plan.

Luis FinOps: I'll pull last 90d token trend and projected runway under current usage. Sending a short forecast in a sec. :bar_chart:

Marcus Analytics: Quick preview: 30d rolling avg is 2.1M tokens/day, spike on 2025-11-03 from batch jobs. If we enable batching + cache we can cut ~25% at peak.

Priya Enablement: I can create a 1-slide enablement for their engineering lead on batching config and KV caching examples. Need config snippets and suggested thresholds.

costbot: Automated alert — Apollo exceeded budget threshold (85%) for the month. Billing link: https://billing.redwood/apollo/overview

Luis FinOps: Forecast snippet (rough):
```
current_avg = 2.1M tokens/day
expected_growth = 1.05  # 5% next quarter
projected_qtr = current_avg * expected_growth * 90 = ~198M tokens
recommended_commit = 180M tokens (with 10% buffer)
```

Maya CSM: Nice — Luis can you also include per-route token breakdown? They use chat-heavy flows and a nightly ingestion pipeline. We should call out the ingestion batch as the spike cause.

Marcus Analytics: On it — sending route-level heatmap by EOD. Also will produce a simulated 'with batching' column so we can show impact in QBR.

Ethan AE: For the one-pager: include an immediate next-step checklist we can share on the call: 1) apply 1.5x rate limit on ingestion job 2) enable prefix caching for user histories 3) set alert at 70% of monthly commit.

Priya Enablement: I'll draft the slide + two short demo snippets: batching config and sample cURL for cache warmup. ETA: tomorrow noon.

Maya CSM: Great. Ownership: Luis — spend forecast + per-route breakdown. Marcus — impact sim and heatmap. Priya — enablement slide + snippets. Ethan — customer call and one-pager. I'll assemble the QBR pack and do rehearsal Mon 9am PT.

Ethan AE: I'll prep answers for renewal questions (commit sizing rationale).

Luis FinOps: Uploaded forecast CSV to the shared folder: https://redwood.share/apollo/forecast.csv. Added comments on anomalies.

Marcus Analytics: Uploaded heatmap and sim CSV to the same folder.

Maya CSM: Perfect. Action owners, drop a quick ✅ when you finish your item so I can finalize the deck.

Priya Enablement: ✅ slide draft uploaded (notes included).

Luis FinOps: ✅ forecast uploaded and updated with per-route costs.

Marcus Analytics: ✅ simulations done, added a 'with-batching' sheet.

Ethan AE: ✅ one-pager draft in the folder, please review before the call.

Maya CSM: Thanks team — I'll do a final sweep tomorrow and ping the customer. Leaving this thread open for any late add-ons. :thumbsup:
